MOBILE_BILLING_CHECK_DUE_DATE: Customer wants to check the due date for their mobile bill payment. They may ask about when the current billing cycle ends, when payment is due, or confirm billing dates. This often involves clarifying whether they use postpaid or prepaid service.
MOBILE_BILLING_PAYMENT_STATUS_POSTPAID: Customer wants to check the payment status, outstanding balance, or billing information for their postpaid (monthly subscription) mobile account. This includes checking due amounts, bill history, payment confirmation, and understanding whether a bill has been paid or is still pending.
MOBILE_BILLING_PAYMENT_STATUS_PREPAID: Customer wants to check the payment status for their prepaid (top-up) SIM card. This includes verifying whether a recent top-up or package purchase transaction was successful, checking remaining credit, and confirming payment completion for prepaid services.
MOBILE_NETWORK_CHECK_NO_SIGNAL: Customer is experiencing no signal or network connectivity issues on their mobile device. This includes reporting no service, no signal bars, inability to make calls or use data, and troubleshooting network problems in a specific area or location.
MOBILE_PACKAGE_CHECK_DATA_CURRENT: Customer wants to check their current active data/internet package. This includes viewing the currently subscribed package name, price, data quota, validity period, and package details for their mobile line.
MOBILE_PACKAGE_CHECK_DATA_HISTORY: Customer wants to check their historical data/internet package usage. This includes viewing past package subscriptions, data consumption history, package changes over time, add-on purchases, and usage patterns across previous months.
MOBILE_ROAMING_CHECK_DATA_CURRENT: Customer wants to check their current roaming data balance while traveling abroad. This includes remaining data quota, package expiry, estimating if data will last, and understanding roaming data behavior like hotspot sharing or auto-renewal.
MOBILE_ROAMING_CHECK_PAYMENT_POSTPAID: Customer wants to check roaming charges on their postpaid bill. This includes viewing roaming costs for the current billing cycle, understanding total roaming charges, and verifying payment status for roaming services.
MOBILE_SIM_ACTIVATION_POSTPAID: Customer wants to activate a new or inactive postpaid (monthly subscription) SIM card. This includes requesting immediate activation of a SIM that has not yet been activated, often with urgency due to needing the number for work or travel.
MOBILE_SIM_ACTIVATION_PREPAID: Customer wants to activate a new or inactive prepaid (top-up) SIM card. This includes requesting immediate activation of a recently purchased SIM that has not been activated yet, often with urgency.
MOBILE_SIM_REPLACEMENT_POSPAID: Customer wants to replace or reissue a SIM card for their postpaid (monthly subscription) line while keeping the same phone number. Common reasons include a damaged, broken, or lost SIM card.
MOBILE_SIM_REPLACEMENT_PREPAID: Customer wants to replace or reissue a SIM card for their prepaid (top-up) line while keeping the same phone number. Common reasons include a damaged, broken, or lost SIM card.
MOBILE_USAGE_CHECK_DATA_CURRENT: Customer wants to check their current data/internet usage and remaining balance. This includes viewing how much data has been consumed, how much remains in their package quota, and whether they are close to their data limit.
MOBILE_USAGE_COMPARE_DATA_PLAN: Customer wants to compare available data/internet packages to find the best option. This includes viewing differences between packages in terms of data quota, price, speed, and value to help them choose or switch to a more suitable plan.
MOBILE_VAS_SUBSCRIBE_DATA_HISTORY: Customer wants to check the subscription history for value-added services (VAS). This includes viewing past subscriptions to services like ringtones, horoscope readings, SMS news alerts, and other add-on services across previous months.
MOBILE_VAS_SUBSCRIBE_DATA_SPECIFIC_MONTH: Customer wants to subscribe to a specific value-added service (VAS). This includes signing up for services like ringtones, horoscope readings, SMS news alerts, and other add-on services.
